purpose: Separate editor allocation traffic, natural collector trace events and resident process accounting; avoid repeated serialization and accidental string backing-store retention.

runtime.note: Upstream tagged source was read; this is not byte-for-byte verification of Electron's patched V8 binary.

book.title: Operating Systems: Three Easy Pieces
book.authors: Remzi H. Arpaci-Dusseau and Andrea C. Arpaci-Dusseau
book.scope: Read the complete extracted chapter text, listing, references and homework prompts. Rendered diagrams were not inspected; homework experiments and linked references were not executed/read.
book.application: A process address space and language-level allocation traffic are not physical resident memory. This phase reports separate app-tree PSS samples instead of equating profiler bytes with RAM savings.

sources.scope: BufferJoin and Add/RepeatLast storage paths; including the single-buffer-string fast path and sequential result allocation.
Sampling flags and GetAllocationProfile call; inspector enables kSamplingForceGC.
GetAllocationProfile implementation; requested profile collection forces diagnostic GC with kSamplingForceGC.
StartObservablePause, UpdateCurrentEvent, StartCycle/atomic phase and StopObservablePause scopes. Event durations are not asserted to be a universal exact stop-the-world metric.
Pinned contentTracing start/stop acknowledgement, trace buffer usage and process buffering API sections.

localSource.scope: ChangeSet length, empty and iterChanges declarations/source; actual Text and ChangeSet differential checks including multi-edit and composed changes.

implementation: Current canonical value is aliased once per editor. Changes materialize inserted Text and one sequential result string; exact parent echoes bypass serialization. Single-piece joins are split to avoid V8's return-original-string fast path. Bounded metadata scans replace per-line split/regex arrays. CR-bearing raw inputs retain the existing canonicalization fallback.
notClaimed: A universal V8 string-layout guarantee across future runtimes
Production forced GC or heap flags
A new native runtime dependency or Rust bridge
Constant-space dirty text or undo history
